help: Spawns a hostile Omega fleet of Tesseracts fitted with the Cascade Resonator MRM roughly 800 units away, set to intercept you. Defaults to 2 ships; pass a count between 1 and 20 to change that. Campaign map only. Intended for testing SmartSwarmSRMs, not for normal play.

Teleports your fleet to a Coronal Hypershunt, arriving 600 units out. Defaults to the nearest one measured in hyperspace; if the sector has more than one they are listed and you can pass an index to pick another. Campaign map only, and not while docked. Useful for checking which Omega variants actually spawn as hypershunt guardians.
